headline: Star Wars: The original 1977 movie returns to theaters
post:
Big changes are coming to a galaxy far, far away as Lucasfilm gears up for a massive milestone next year. According to Screen Rant, the original untampered movie is heading back to theaters on February 19, 2027, after a copy was found at the British Film Institute archives and digitally remastered for IMAX.

The franchise is also looking forward with new co-presidents Dave Filoni and Lynwen Brennan taking charge. On the big screen, Shawn Levy's Starfighter will star Ryan Gosling alongside Flynn Gray, Matt Smith, and Mia Goth, set five years after the sequel trilogy. Meanwhile, Disney+ will bring back Ahsoka for season 2, continuing the epic journey starring Rosario Dawson and Hayden Christensen.

Fans can also look forward to Star Wars Celebration 2027 in Los Angeles, plus exciting new LEGO sets, Hasbro figures, and books. Which upcoming anniversary project are you most excited to check out?

#StarWars #SciFi #GeekCulture
original_title: Star Wars: Everything Confirmed For Next Year's 50th Anniversary Celebrations, Ranked By Hype

headline: Batman defeats DC's strongest heroes and villains
post:
Batman relies on tactical judgment rather than brute force alone to overcome godlike opponents. According to Screen Rant, the Dark Knight has defeated numerous powerful figures throughout DC history. 🦇

During the Joker-driven assault in Batman: Endgame, he utilized specialized gear like his Justice Buster armor and dehydrating foam to subdue Aquaman. He also famously used Kryptonite-laced gum to stop a mind-controlled Superman. Other major triumphs include outsmarting the alien Hyperclan with fire and utilizing a White Lantern ring to revive himself and overpower Vandal Savage.

Which of these incredible comic book battles is your absolute favorite?

original_title: 10 Strongest Superheroes And Villains Batman Has Beaten In Official DC Canon
